title: Mika hình thái 2 · vào/rời sân + di chuyển Quảng Trường (sheet run)
style: Static locked camera, three-quarter view facing screen-right, matching the reference, the whole body and weapon always inside the frame with a margin, her face visible, the flat solid magenta background never changes. Clean anime game sprite animation, crisp lines. Hair, cloth and tails always keep moving with natural delay and follow-through, never frozen.

segments.name: X
segments.prompt: A chibi fox-girl swordswoman in black and gold plate armour with a red scarf and long red cape tails, wielding a big broad greatsword with a wide silver blade, from her guard stance first settles the rigid weapon, holding the greatsword with its broad blade resting on her right shoulder, then begins a steady run in place toward screen-right: locked stationary camera, no horizontal drift, pan, zoom or turn. Her legs alternate in a clear running gait with clear foot contacts, her free arm pumps and her torso bobs subtly; she keeps the same pace to the end. Hair, cape and tails stream and bounce behind her. Arms, shoulders and torso drive the weapon action; hair, cloth and tails follow with natural overlapping motion. Preserve her identity, costume, proportions and the single rigid weapon, always drawn whole and clearly visible. No added flames, aura or particles.
